verdict.rationale: LegalZoom offers a registered agent service. It handles the paperwork to switch your current registered agent to LegalZoom and covers the state fees. It also sends an alert as soon as official mail arrives, provides unlimited cloud document storage, and adds annual-report deadline reminders, so the core of the story is delivered. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that mail and service of process are scanned and viewable online (the docs only promise an alert), any explicit mention of service of process handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
